description: List Novig markets with best bid, implied ask, last price, volume and open interest, filtered by league, event, market type, player, team or status. Costs 1 credit per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/markets. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

league.description: League code, such as NBA or NFL.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 50. Free returns at most 100.

status.description: open, closed, settled, suspended or all.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_markets
